data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 373.174m. During 2019 there was net adverse prior year reserve development driven by loss reserve strengthening in relation to typhoon Jebi and other loss deterioration in Treaty Property and Third-party Liability classes; a gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 12.79m (around 3.4% of opening gross reserves) was calculated from the gross claims development table. The reserve movement primarily reflects natural catastrophe and large-loss developments, particularly within property/treaty and third-party liability exposures.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) GBP 000 column for 2018 (prior year). Prior-year development (gross) calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 43 because the movement note and P&L narrative provide only net prior-year figures (e.g. 'adverse prior year development of GBP 11.6m' is net). The gross PYD derived from the triangle is +GBP 12.79m (strengthening). Numbers in the triangle are presented in GBP 000; conversion to GBP m performed for summary fields. No RITC distortion was identified in the notes. Where movements by LOB are discussed in narrative they are not quantified, so LOB-specific amounts are null.
